_how: Copy to corpus_expectations.json, then edit. That file is gitignored, because
its contents describe your library and not this skill.
Each key is a package directory relative to DECIPHER_DQ_CORPUS, in the form
<name>/<vN>. Each entry names a check you expect to fire there, and
optionally a substring the finding must mention.
Write one entry per defect you already know about: a compile error you spent
a round trip on, a parameter the demo sets but the package never declared, a
stale version string, an asset the demo names but does not ship. If verify
cannot find a defect you know is there, the check is wrong, not the library.
